description: Create a recurring agent mission. Firing it — on schedule, or immediately via run_scheduled_task — creates an ordinary tracker issue assigned to the agent, which drives a normal pipeline run: a scheduled task is a stored mission request, not a new execution mode. This tool calls the SHIP API, documented at https://letsship.ai/docs/api. Requires the config:write capability.

dayOfMonth.description: Day of month, 1-28 — required when interval is 'monthly' (capped at 28 so every month has the day).

enabled.description: Whether the schedule is armed (default true)

interval.description: Fire cadence. 'weekly' requires weekday; 'monthly' requires dayOfMonth.

labels.description: Tracker label names put on every issue this scheduled task files (default none). The label must ALREADY exist in the project's tracker team — the platform attaches labels but cannot create them, so a name the workspace does not have is dropped.

name.description: Scheduled task name, shown in the console and used in the issue title

projectId.description: Project id the scheduled task belongs to

prompt.description: Becomes the created issue's description verbatim on every fire

skipIfPreviousOpen.description: Skip a scheduled fire while the previous fire's mission is still open (default true — the guardrail is opt-out, not opt-in)

templateKey.description: Attribution only, when authored from a template — see list_scheduled_task_templates

weekday.description: Day of week — required when interval is 'weekly'.

name: create_scheduled_task
title: Create a scheduled task
